coordinates.note: Approximate, campus-grade: the centre of the OpenStreetMap area of the Stawell Gold Mine (bounding box about 2 km across). No official SUPL or SABRE page read gives a latitude and longitude, and the laboratory itself lies 1 km underground along the mine decline, so this is the surface mine area and not the laboratory position. The official address is 'Stawell Gold Mines, 43 Reefs Road, Stawell Victoria 3380' (supl.org.au).
